relations.rationale: Team membership of Jun and Hana has no bearing on whether the pack disappeared around the first bend.
Milo being nearly six feet tall supports him towering over other cyclists at the water station.
Milo's height has no connection to Isla checking her watch.
Checking her watch plausibly leads to and supports her noting the race timing.
Isla checking her watch has no bearing on Milo and Hana's team membership.
The timing of the race start has no bearing on Isla's ranking from a previous year.
Spectators lining the fences is a separate detail from the sun breaking through, and these events can coincide but are not inherently linked.
Spectators gathering suggests anticipation of the race, which could support the pack surging forward, but is largely independent context.
Spectators waving flags as numbers are read has no direct bearing on the pack disappearing around the bend.
Jun finishing stretching plausibly leads to him rejoining the others, supporting a sequential connection.
Jun rejoining others at the timing mats has no bearing on the sun breaking through at the horn.
Hana ranking fourth is consistent with and supports her ranking just ahead of Isla if Isla ranked fifth.
Hana ranking fourth is consistent with Isla ranking fifth, supporting that claim.
Hana ranking just ahead of Isla directly supports Isla having finished fifth if Hana was fourth.
The sun breaking through as the horn sounded coincides with and supports the pack surging forward at the race start.
The pack surging forward onto the road directly supports and leads into them disappearing around the first bend.
